components.name: User Message Bubble
components.description: Right-aligned speaker bubble in Sage Whisper with a Field Sage border tint.
components.html: Build me a strength-focused push day
components.css: .ds-msg { max-width: min(760px, 84%); padding: 15px 18px; border: 1px solid #d7c9b7; border-radius: 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.7; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #1f1d1a; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31,29,26,0.02); } .ds-msg-user { align-self: flex-end; background: #e4ebdf; border-color: rgba(84,107,82,0.2); }

components.name: Assistant Message Bubble
components.description: Left-aligned speaker bubble in translucent white.
components.html: Here's a push day: bench press, overhead press, dips, and lateral raises — 4 sets each, 6–8 reps for the compounds.
components.css: .ds-msg { max-width: min(760px, 84%); padding: 15px 18px; border: 1px solid #d7c9b7; border-radius: 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.7; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #1f1d1a; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31,29,26,0.02); } .ds-msg-assistant { align-self: flex-start; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

components.name: Pending Message
components.description: In-progress state — assistant bubble with dashed border and reduced opacity.
components.css: .ds-msg { max-width: min(760px, 84%); padding: 15px 18px; border: 1px solid #d7c9b7; border-radius: 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.7; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #1f1d1a; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31,29,26,0.02); } .ds-msg-pending { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); opacity: 0.72; border-style: dashed; }

components.name: Error Message
components.description: Failure state bubble in Terracotta tint.
components.css: .ds-msg { max-width: min(760px, 84%); padding: 15px 18px; border-radius: 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.7; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-msg-error { border: 1px solid rgba(143,81,71,0.25); background: rgba(143,81,71,0.04); color: #8f5147; }

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Filled Field Sage pill with uppercase tracked label and green shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-send { min-width: 110px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #546b52; color: white; padding: 12px 18px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(84,107,82,0.12); } .ds-btn-send:hover { background: #3f553f; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(84,107,82,0.18); } .ds-btn-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #546b52; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-send:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Reset Button
components.description: Ghost pill. Pressed Linen border, transparent background, hover reveals Field Sage accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-reset { border: 1px solid #d7c9b7; background: transparent; color: #1f1d1a; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-reset:hover { border-color: #546b52; background: rgba(84,107,82,0.04); } .ds-btn-reset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #546b52; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Prompt Chip
components.description: Ghost pill quick-prompt. Subtle white tint, lifts 1px on hover toward Field Sage.
components.css: .ds-prompt-chip { border: 1px solid #d7c9b7; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: #1f1d1a; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease-out, border-color 0.18s ease-out, background 0.18s ease-out, box-shadow 0.18s ease-out; } .ds-prompt-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(84,107,82,0.45); background: rgba(84,107,82,0.04); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(31,29,26,0.04); } .ds-prompt-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #546b52; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: 34×34px square mark. 8px radius, Field Sage border and tint, Deep Forest text.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid rgba(84,107,82,0.4); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(84,107,82,0.07); color: #3f553f; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

narrative.overview:
The Fitness Agent is built on the aesthetic of a well-kept training notebook: warm paper, reliable ink, sparing use of a muted green accent that feels more field than gym. The visual language draws from analog tools — the parchment warmth of the background, the tight-tracked uppercase labels of a form sheet, the serif typography that appears only for editorial moments — while staying fully functional as a modern web application.

The key tension the design resolves: a fitness tool should feel capable without feeling clinical. This system achieves that through material warmth (the earthy palette), editorial authority (the serif display type), and restraint in decoration (Field Sage appears on fewer than three elements per screen). The result is a surface that a user would feel comfortable spending focused time inside — not a dashboard to check, but a desk to sit at.

Density is medium. Panels are generous but bounded. The two-column workspace gives the brief sidebar and conversation panel distinct territories without crowding either.
keyCharacteristics: Warm earthy palette rooted in organic neutrals, not corporate blue
Serif used only at editorial scale — hero heading and brief panel title
Field Sage accent is scarce: brand mark, hero span, send button only
Structural shadows signal hierarchy; they are warm, not cool
Pill radius for interactive controls; panel radius for containers; never mixed
Uppercase tracked labels form a secondary typographic register across all metadata

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Field Sage appears on the send button, the brand mark, and the hero h1 accent span — three placements. Adding a fourth is a system violation.

rules.name: The No-Cool-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every gray in this system has a warm undertone. Do not substitute a neutral gray (#888, #ccc, #f5f5f5) — the warmth is load-bearing.

rules.name: The Field Notes Rule
rules.body: Serif is an editorial instrument. It appears only on the two largest headings (Display and Headline). Every other element uses the sans.

rules.name: The Tracked Label Rule
rules.body: Every UI label, metadata string, or button text uses letter-spacing: 0.12–0.16em and text-transform: uppercase. Conversational text never uses tracking.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted warm (rgba(31, 29, 26, ...)) or olive-green for the send button. A cool-gray shadow reads as a different product.

rules.name: The Radius Assignment Rule
rules.body: Containers use 14px (bubble) or 18px (panel). Controls use 999px (pill). Brand mark uses 8px. Do not round a container to 999px or make a button 18px.

dos: Do use Iowan Old Style only for the Display heading and the Headline brief title.
Do reserve Field Sage for its three designated placements: send button, brand mark, hero h1 accent span.
Do keep all borders and dividers in Pressed Linen (#d7c9b7) — the line color is a system-wide invariant.
Do tint all shadows warm (rgba(31, 29, 26, ...)) or olive-green for the send button.
Do use pill radius (999px) for interactive controls and panel radius (18px) for containers.
Do apply the uppercase tracked label register to all metadata, labels, eyebrows, and button text.
donts: Don't introduce a pure white (#ffffff) background or a neutral gray — the warmth is the system's material identity.
Don't use a cool-tinted or pure-black shadow — it reads as a foreign component.
Don't use the serif font below Headline scale.
Don't add a fourth accent placement beyond the three specified.
Don't apply border-radius: 18px to interactive controls or 999px to containers.
Don't add uppercase tracking to conversational or instructional text.
